//: Composite indexes for the queries in src/services/syncService.ts.
Those are the ONLY queries that reach Firestore. Every screen reads SQLite
instead (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), so the support queue's ordering is a SQL
CASE expression in ticketRepository.listQueue() and needs nothing here.
The full Firestore query inventory, and why each does or does not need an entry:
pullRemote, student   where createdBy == uid AND updatedAt > cursor
watchForChanges, stu. where createdBy == uid, orderBy updatedAt desc
-> single field, automatic, no entry needed
-> single field, automatic, no entry needed
pullComments          where createdAt > cursor, on tickets/{id}/comments
-> single field, automatic, no entry needed
Firestore creates single-field indexes for every field by default, which is
why the three support/comment queries are absent rather than forgotten.
Add an entry here only if a query gains a second field.

indexes.//: pullRemote() for a student: their own tickets, changed since the last pull.
watchForChanges() for a student: newest of their own tickets.
